content.subject: Sightseeing tours
content.body:
Hello,
I will be staying in your city for five days in July. I'd like to see some interesting places
during that time. Could you please give me some information about the sightseeing tours
that your company offers?
Thanks,
M. Lee
content.instruction: Respond to the e-mail as if you work for a tour company. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and ask ONE question.

content.prompt: What are some disadvantages of attending a school located far from your hometown?
